title: Lip frenum surgery (frenectomy)
what: The doctor changes a short lip frenum - the fold between the lip and the gum. Afterwards the lip moves more freely and does not pull on the gum.
why: When the frenum causes a gap between the front teeth, pulls on the gum or gets in the way of braces treatment.
duration: the procedure usually takes 15 to 30 minutes
tell_doctor: Blood diseases, or taking blood thinners
If your child wears braces or a retainer

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Eat, or feed your child, 1 to 2 hours before the procedure.

prepare.title: Teeth
prepare.text: Brush your teeth before the visit.

bring: A referral from the orthodontist, if you have one
steps: The doctor examines the lip and frenum
The frenum is cut and reshaped with a scalpel or laser
Thin stitches are placed, if needed
The small wound is pressed with gauze
feel: The numbing injection is unpleasant, then you feel only pressure
Afterwards the lip is numb for 1 to 2 hours
It aches and swells a little for a few days
after: Do not eat until the numbness is gone
For 1 to 2 days eat soft, not hot food
Do not pull the lip away to look at the wound
Rinse your mouth as your doctor says
Stitches are removed or dissolve - your doctor will say
red_flags: Bleeding does not stop when you press on it
Severe swelling of the lip, or fever above 38

faq.q: Will the gap between the teeth close by itself?
faq.a: Sometimes yes, sometimes an orthodontist is needed. The doctor will tell you what to expect.

faq.q: When can I brush my teeth?
faq.a: Usually the same day, carefully going around the wound.

reminders.text: Lip frenum surgery tomorrow. Eat 1 to 2 hours before your visit and brush your teeth.
